bullets.text: Two construction workers died in separate electrocution incidents in Nanganallur and Ambattur in Chennai, and the office should monitor safety compliance.
The High Court permitted the DMK to file a defamation suit seeking Rs 1.01 crore against ministers Aadhav Arjuna, Nirmal Kumar, and TVK IT wing.
An IIT Madras-led study found that atmospheric aerosols can help sharpen extreme-rainfall and urban-flood forecasts in Chennai.
The Tamil Nadu government announced that 5,000 volunteers are ready for flood mitigation and disaster-related works during the monsoon.
The Greater Chennai Corporation completed 57 flood-mitigation works under the Thiruppugazh Committee recommendations, spending Rs 307.51 crore.
Women in Ponneri besieged the block development office demanding safe drinking water and 100 days of work.
Railway police in Tiruvallur district praised two college students for returning a lost bag containing 20 sovereigns of gold and Rs 1.91 lakh.
Thiruttani Murugan Temple generated Rs 1.37 crore in hundi collections over 24 days, according to official reports.
Bharat1.AI is building an AI township near Bengaluru's Agara Lake where humans, digital twins, and robots will coexist.
India's data centre capacity hit 1.75 GW according to a CBRE report, with strong demand led by hyperscalers.
Google is nearing a nuclear power deal with Constellation Energy to supply clean energy for its data centres amid the AI boom.
Dinamani reported on a conflict between AIADMK and TVK regarding token distribution.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister MK Stalin are set to travel together on the Chennai Metro on October 11.
